adjudication.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` the code does `host = uri.host` and then queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. Since `lower(host)` is compared to the *un-downcased* `host` parameter, a referer/embed_url with uppercase characters (e.g. `EvilTrout.com`) will not match in a case-sensitive DB (e.g. Postgres), incorrectly making `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` return false. This directly affects `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` (changed to use `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`) and `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` (also changed), potentially rejecting valid hosts. (Note: the finding’s claim that `TopicEmbed.import` “downcases the same url a step later” isn’t supported by the diff; it also calls `record_for_host(url)`.)
